'''Kinetic Blast''' is an [[attack]] [[skill]] that fires a [[projectile]] from a [[wand]], causing explosions around the location of the projectile's impact, dealing damage to enemies caught in their [[area of effect]].

==Skill functions and interactions==
'''Damage calculations''': Only {{c|mod|increases}} and {{c|mod|reductions}} to Spell Damage are applied to attacks. {{c|mod|More}} and {{c|mod|less}} modifiers do '''not''' apply to attacks.

'''Explosions''': Explosions occur ''around'' each collision, divided across equal arcs (like pizza slices). When there is no space in an arc to create an explosion, the explosion for that arc is skipped. A typical-sized target is not hit by explosions created from a collision against them, and because modifiers to [[area of effect]] apply to both the explosions' spread and size, increasing or reducing the aoe does not cause overlap against a single target.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=whQO-0RktzM</ref> Greater area will however increase coverage against multiple targets.

'''Multiple Projectiles''': Because each collision can create explosions, and each explosion can hit each target inside its area, the number of hits against multiple enemies or enemies near terrain can be greatly increased by firing additional projectiles, such as with {{il|Greater Multiple Projectiles Support}}. [[Projectile#'Shotgunning'|Shotgun]] prevention will still limit the number of direct collision from each set of simultaneous projectiles to 1 per enemy, however. 

'''Projectile behaviours''': Unlike {{il|Fireball}}, Kinetic Blast projectiles do not need to end to create aoe effects. Explosions will be created on collision, even when the projectile continues with [[Split]], [[Pierce]], [[Fork]], [[Chain]] or [[Return]]. 

'''Targets''': In addition to enemies and terrain, projectiles may also create explosions from collisions with {{il|Tornado}} and {{il|Hydrosphere}}, which may be [[trigger]]ed by Kinetic Blast through {{il|Spellslinger}}.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Skills, Items and Modifiers that once stated that Increases and Reductions to Spell Damage also apply to Attack Damage have been replaced with the new Arcane Might Keyword. This is purely a desciptive change.
* Kinetic Blast: Now has 150% Arcane Might (previously 200%), and 40% less Area Damage (previously 35%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1 (previously 15), scaling up to 9 at gem level 20 (previously 16).
* Now has an Attack Speed of 115% of Base (previously 100%).
* It also now has "Increases and Reductions to Spell Damage also apply to Attack Damage from this Skill at 200% of their Value".
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* No longer has 0-19% increased Area of Effect.
* Quality now causes the skill to create 0-1 explosions, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.13.0|
* Kinetic Blast and {{il|Storm Call}} have brand new effects.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.0|
* Now has alternative gem quality.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.10.0|
* Now deals base damage and has an added damage effectiveness of 140% at gem level 1 (from 120%), up to 155% at gem level 20 (from 147%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.4.0|
* Now deals 35% less Area Damage (down from 25% less).
* Explosion placement has been reworked. They are now divided across 4 equal arcs (like pizza slices). In cases where there is no space in an arc that it could place an explosion, that explosion is not placed. Explosion spacing is also now more regular. The net result is that in open spaces, the area coverage will, on average, be more even, but single-target damage in tight spaces is now lower.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.6.0|
* Kinetic Blast's radius has increased from 10 to 14. Kinetic Blast's spread of explosions has also been increased to avoid overlapping with the primary target as a result of the changes to the explosion radius.
* Increased Area of Effect radius replaced with Increased Area of Effect
}}
{{Version history table row|1.3.0d|
* The art for Kinetic Blast has been made blue to prevent it from appearing disabled when it is active.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.3.0|
* Kinetic Blast has been added to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
